The '''Annoo system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Tharin sector/Legends|Tharin sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] formerly known as [[Annoo (Gelefil)|Gelefil]] and the original planet [[Annoo (original)|Annoo]] were located in this system. Furthermore, the [[Nimat Corridor]] passed through this system.
